criteria.title: Valid SVG
criteria.description: The response includes a complete, syntactically valid SVG that renders without external assets.

criteria.title: Google Identification
criteria.description: The rendered logo clearly identifies the brand as Google, such as through a legible “Google” wordmark.

candidates.source: If the rendered logo contains a clearly legible wordmark spelled exactly “Google,” return True; otherwise, return False.
If the rendered logo identifies the brand through a readable Google wordmark, even with stylized lettering or altered capitalization, return True; otherwise, return False.
If the rendered logo clearly evokes Google through its wordmark or other distinctive brand cues, return True; otherwise, return False.

criteria.title: Contemporary Design
criteria.description: The logo uses a visually contemporary style rather than looking dated or unfinished.

candidates.source: If the rendered logo appears intentional and does not look obviously dated or unfinished, return True; otherwise, return False.
If the rendered logo uses a cohesive contemporary visual style with clean shapes and deliberate color choices, return True; otherwise, return False.

If the rendered logo looks polished and distinctly contemporary, with balanced composition, consistent geometry, and no visible rendering defects or unfinished elements, return True; otherwise, return False.

criteria.title: Creative Redesign
criteria.description: The design offers a distinctive visual interpretation rather than merely reproducing the familiar Google logo.

candidates.source: If the design includes at least one noticeable creative change from the familiar Google logo, return True; otherwise, return False.
If the design presents a distinctive visual interpretation rather than simply changing the familiar logo’s font or colors, return True; otherwise, return False.
If the design uses an original visual concept as its primary identity rather than relying on the familiar Google wordmark or multicolored “G,” return True; otherwise, return False.

criteria.title: Distinctive Lettering
criteria.description: The wordmark uses custom-drawn or otherwise deliberately styled lettering rather than relying solely on an unmodified generic font.

candidates.source: If the SVG wordmark uses individually custom-drawn letterforms with distinctive shapes, return True; otherwise, return False.
If the wordmark uses custom letterforms or visibly modifies a font to create distinctive lettering, return True; otherwise, return False.
If the wordmark shows deliberate typographic styling beyond simply rendering “Google” in an unmodified generic font, return True; otherwise, return False.

criteria.title: Integrated Color
criteria.description: Color is applied intentionally across the main logo or wordmark, rather than appearing only in a separate generic icon.

candidates.source: If the SVG applies color to at least part of the main logo or wordmark, rather than only to a separate icon, return True; otherwise, return False.
If color is applied intentionally across the main logo or wordmark and contributes to its visual identity, return True; otherwise, return False.
If multiple colors are integrated directly into prominent elements across the main logo or wordmark, rather than confined to isolated accents or a separate icon, return True; otherwise, return False.

criteria.title: Visual Cohesion
criteria.description: The logo’s letterforms, colors, stroke weights, and any decorative elements form a unified design.

criteria.title: Legibility
criteria.description: The letters are recognizable and distinguishable at normal viewing sizes.

criteria.title: Balanced Composition
criteria.description: The logo has consistent spacing, alignment, and proportions, with no unintended overlaps or clipping.

candidates.source: If all logo elements have consistent spacing, precise alignment, proportional sizing, and no unintended overlaps or clipping, return True; otherwise, return False.
If the logo appears visually balanced overall, with no noticeable unintended overlaps or clipping, return True; otherwise, return False.
If the logo has no major spacing, alignment, proportion, overlap, or clipping problems that disrupt its composition, return True; otherwise, return False.

criteria.title: Scalability
criteria.description: The design remains clear and recognizable when scaled down.

criteria.title: Accessibility
criteria.description: The SVG provides an accessible name or description identifying the logo.
